title: The Secret Role of the Spleen in Your Health
description:
The spleen is one of the most fascinating and underrated organs in the human body. But what exactly does it do? In this video, we explore the function of the spleen, from filtering blood and recycling red blood cells to boosting immunity and fighting infections. You’ll discover why doctors call the spleen the body’s "blood bank" and "immune powerhouse." We also bust common myths about the spleen and explain how it impacts your overall health. Join us as Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the science of the spleen in a simple, engaging way.
